requirements.statement: Provide an explicitly invoked Claude Code SDD plugin without permission grants or model calls during validation.
acceptance: Seven documented skills exist and official plugin validation passes.
An isolated local install exposes the plugin and skills without changing real user settings.

requirements.statement: Initialize selected workspaces and create drafts while preserving existing files and filesystem boundaries.
acceptance: Dry-run and repeated initialization do not overwrite manual work.
Symlink destinations and invalid feature IDs are rejected; explicit-target draft creation works.

requirements.statement: Report specification state without exposing document contents or executing embedded commands.
acceptance: Reports contain identifiers, statuses, counts and fixed diagnostic codes only.
Invalid specs fail deterministically and tests cover content leakage and traversal boundaries.

decisions.summary: Use an optional root plugin with user-invoked skills and bounded local helpers, inherited permissions and isolated install validation.

tasks.summary: Add metadata, marketplace and seven scoped skills.
Add safe initialization and explicit-target draft creation.
Add content-free status and boundary regressions.
Validate and record local and isolated installation evidence.

checks.summary: Run workspace and plugin contract regression tests; native validator and isolated installation evidence are recorded in verification.md.
